about_the_game:
🕹️ About the Game

PolyCrime is a systemic open-city crime sim where every choice has consequences. Make money, grow your influence, and protect your respect. The city remembers: gangs react to your moves, cops track you, and your Steam friends can strike via the darkweb when you least expect it.

🚀 Early Access (EA)

Available on day one

  • 🌱 Drug growing & production
    Cultivate, process and mix strains. Tune effects, yields and risk.

  • 🖥️ Online Marketplace (in-game PC)
    Player-to-player trading of items, materials and loot.
    Selected items are tradeable via Steam Workshop (Steam inventory).

  • 💎 Server-run Collectibles
    Random “trash” finds and rare limited pieces for crafting or pure flex.
    Each collection has a hard cap – once fully collected, it stops spawning.

  • 🤝 Choice: collaborate with gangs or ignore them
    Alliances bring perks; ignoring brings consequences. Your reputation spreads.

  • 🌆 Living, breathing city
    NPCs have memory, relationships and motivations. Make allies, rivals and contacts.

  • 🚓 Police, gangs & corruption
    Evade patrols, bribe, or tamper with evidence — if you can get away with it.

  • 🏢 Empire building
    Upgrade hideouts, hire dealers and enforcers, take over city blocks.

  • 🎭 Reputation & status
    Fear, loyalty or respect — your standing with gangs, cops and civilians matters.

  • 🎰 Multiplayer casino & 🏆 global events
    Sit at tables with real players and compete for exclusive rewards.

Darkweb (EA start)

  • 💻 Bank account hacks against other players to siphon their funds.

🧭 Road to Full Game (added over EA)

  • 🌐 Expanded darkweb

    • Trigger DEA raids on enemy stashes/grows

    • Hire a hitman against another player

    • Hire a thief (chance to steal items)

    • ⚔️ PvP invasions — enter another player’s city in real time

  • 🏪 Business ownership
    Supermarket, gas station, nightclub and more — passive & active income.

  • 🤝 Co-op
    Shared play with friends, build an empire together.

  • 📦 Distribution hub & air cargo
    Package shipments, face dynamic inspections, and outsmart detection.

  • 🔧 Weapon crafting + rarities
    Unique pieces not everyone will have — tradeable on the marketplace.

  • 🗃️ Completed collectibles ecosystem
    Seasons with curated drops and odds. A long-term hunt for collectors.

  • 👑 Endgame: take over a gang and rule the city
    Command a faction, expand your empire, protect it with your “army,” maximize profits.

💡 Summary

PolyCrime offers a deep, replayable simulation of city crime, survival, and strategy. With dynamic systems, emergent gameplay, and multiple progression paths — legal or illegal — your story is yours to write.

Will you become a feared kingpin, a respected entrepreneur, or just another name lost to the streets?

We want to steer the game in the direction our community chooses. On our Discord, you can already submit ideas you’re missing in games or haven’t seen anywhere else.

What the community votes for will be added to the game. Join in, vote, and shape the future of PolyCrime.

⚠️ Disclaimer

FoxGameDev Studio does not endorse or promote real-life violence, crime, drug use, or illegal behavior.

All content is fictional and intended for mature, responsible audiences.

The game encourages player choice and freedom within a stylized simulation world.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult themes including drug production, trafficking, and usage. It features strong language, criminal activities such as illegal trade and gun violence, and depictions of police chases and arrests. Some NPCs may react to drug deals by alerting authorities.

Player choices may include morally ambiguous or illegal actions, such as bribery, money laundering, and gang warfare.

There are no depictions of sexual content, rape, or non-consensual acts.
